Name: Hizashi as Sam
Author: TheDevilRoll
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Hizashi Yamada is not my original character, all rights go to Kōhei Horikoshi and Hideyuki Furuhashi. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]A small little portrait + sprite mod to turn Sam into Hizashi Yamada from Vigilantes series[/color]


[color=#D4D4D8]A small little portrait + sprite mod to turn Sam into Hizashi Yamada specifically Aizawa from Vigilantes series. This Mod changes every portrait and sprite of Sam into Hizashi Yamada. Sam's name is changed to Hizashi in his Portrait and Social Tab. I did make this one a little bit more special! Hizashi hair is down in his Winter outfit! honestly it's one of my favorites and least favorite. His portraits were h e double hockey sticks. his portrait had more special designs than any other character so i hope you like it![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Dialogue can be changed using the "My Hero Valley Conversion" Mod that is now uploaded. Abigial's name is changed to Nemuri already but my sprites for her are not yet ready to upload. they'll be added soon. you can temporarily remove the dialogue for her by using GMCM. This mod will convert dialogue and names when called to their names. for example Sam will be labeled as Hizashi when mentioned by other characters.[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is the third mod i've made, and i would love to make more. I've been looking into making a mod of an entire expansion of my hero but i do not have the qualifications and understanding of how to mod that. if there are modders wanting to collab i'd be happy to create the sprites and portraits. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]I do NOT know if this mod works with Maggs Immersive Sam Romance or Spicy Expansion. [/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
4. Launch the game using SMAPI 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Changes the Portrait and Sprite of Sam[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI (4.4.0 or later)
Content Patcher (2.90 or better) [/color]
